name: North Carolina Department of Public Safety
source_citation: NC DPS & Emergency Management Strategic Plan 2025-2029 (NC OSBM)
mission: Safeguarding and preserving the lives and property of North Carolinians through state-of-the-art disaster prevention, emergency management, law enforcement, and juvenile justice.

goals.title: Disaster Mitigation, Flood Resilience, and Emergency Preparedness
goals.citation: NC DPS Strategic Plan, Section 5.1, pp. 11-17
goals.description: Strengthen North Carolina's resilience to major hurricanes, severe flooding, and tornadoes through FEMA Building Resilient Infrastructure and Communities (BRIC) projects and repetitive flood loss property acquisitions.
objectives: Elevate and floodproof critical public facilities in 100-year and 500-year floodplains
Implement voluntary property buyouts for repetitive flood-loss homes in coastal and riverine counties
Modernize North Carolina Emergency Management regional staging warehouses and mobile command posts

goals.title: Next Generation 911 & FirstNet Tactical Interoperability
goals.citation: NC DPS Strategic Plan, Section 5.2, pp. 18-24
goals.description: Complete statewide NG911 geospatial call routing, upgrade emergency dispatch centers with real-time video/data ingestion, and harden first responder radio communications towers.
objectives: Ensure 100% of North Carolina public safety answering points (PSAPs) are connected to NG911
Deploy redundant satellite backup links for mountain emergency dispatch centers
Standardize mutual aid encrypted radio channels for state troopers, county sheriffs, and local police

goals.title: Statewide Cybersecurity & Critical Infrastructure Protection
goals.citation: NC DPS Strategic Plan, Section 5.3, pp. 25-31
goals.description: Defend state agencies, county water utilities, electrical substations, and local court networks against foreign state and ransomware cyber threats through the State and Local Cybersecurity Grant Program (SLCGP).
objectives: Deploy continuous 24/7 security operations center (SOC) monitoring across all 100 county governments
Conduct red-team vulnerability assessments for municipal drinking water SCADA systems
Provide incident response strike teams for local governments experiencing ransomware attacks

goals.title: Juvenile Justice Reform & Community Violence Intervention
goals.citation: NC DPS Strategic Plan, Section 5.4, pp. 32-38
goals.description: Invest in hospital-based violence intervention programs, evidence-based youth delinquency diversion, and trauma-informed behavioral support for justice-involved teens.
objectives: Expand community-based violence interruption and credible messenger programs in high-crime neighborhoods
Establish regional juvenile crisis stabilization centers to divert youths from detention facilities
Fund vocational apprenticeships and high school completion programs for youthful offenders
